<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Mansi Nishad — Data Analyst</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --pink: #f472b6;
  --purple: #a78bfa;
  --cyan: #22d3ee;
  --green: #4ade80;
  --amber: #fbbf24;
  --bg: #07050f;
  --bg2: #0d0b1a;
  --bg3: #120f22;
  --border: rgba(167,139,250,0.15);
  --text: #e2e8f0;
  --muted: #64748b;
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

body::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: 
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 50% at 20% 10%, rgba(167,139,250,0.06) 0%, transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 80% 80%, rgba(244,114,182,0.05) 0%, transparent 60%);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

.container {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2rem 1.5rem 3rem;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* ─── HERO ─── */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(167,139,250,0.08), 0 0 120px rgba(244,114,182,0.04);
  min-height: 290px;
}

.hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
  filter: brightness(0.22) saturate(1.1) blur(1px);
}

.hero-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(7,5,15,0.88) 0%, rgba(13,11,26,0.7) 50%, rgba(7,5,15,0.55) 100%);
}

.hero-overlay2 {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--bg) 0%, transparent 55%);
}

/* ─── MATRIX / CODING RAIN CANVAS ─── */
#matrixCanvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  opacity: 0.18;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* Floating code snippets */
.code-float {
  position: absolute;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 9px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
  animation: floatCode linear infinite;
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0;
}

@keyframes floatCode {
  0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0px); }
  10%  { opacity: 1; }
  80%  { opacity: 0.6; }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-60px); }
}

/* Shimmer border top */
.hero::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--purple), var(--pink), var(--cyan), transparent);
  animation: shimmer 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  z-index: 10;
}

@keyframes shimmer {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; }
  50% { opacity: 1; }
}

.hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 5;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2rem;
  padding: 2.5rem 2.5rem 2rem;
  min-height: 290px;
}

/* ─── AVATAR ─── */
.avatar-wrap {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: relative;
  width: 144px;
  height: 144px;
}

/* Spinning conic ring */
.avatar-ring {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: conic-gradient(var(--pink), var(--purple), var(--cyan), var(--green), var(--pink));
  animation: spin 3s linear infinite;
  z-index: 0;
}

.avatar-ring-mask {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -3px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--bg);
  z-index: 1;
}

@keyframes spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* Pulse glow */
.avatar-glow {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -15px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(244,114,182,0.25) 0%, transparent 70%);
  animation: pulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  z-index: 0;
}

@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.6; }
  50% { transform: scale(1.12); opacity: 1; }
}

.avatar-img {
  width: 144px;
  height: 144px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: top center;
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  border: 2px solid rgba(244,114,182,0.5);
  /* Bounce/float animation */
  animation: avatarFloat 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes avatarFloat {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px) scale(1); }
  30% { transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.02); }
  60% { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.01); }
}

/* Emoji pop animations */
.emoji-pop {
  position: absolute;
  font-size: 18px;
  z-index: 10;
  animation: emojiAnim 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5));
}

.ep1 { top: -8px; right: -8px; animation-delay: 0s; animation-name: emojiAnim1; }
.ep2 { bottom: 10px; right: -12px; animation-delay: 0.8s; animation-name: emojiAnim2; }
.ep3 { top: 30px; left: -14px; animation-delay: 1.4s; animation-name: emojiAnim3; }

@keyframes emojiAnim1 {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-10deg) scale(1); }
  50% { transform: rotate(15deg) scale(1.2); }
}
@keyframes emojiAnim2 {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(5deg) scale(1); }
  50% { transform: rotate(-15deg) scale(1.25) translateY(-4px); }
}
@keyframes emojiAnim3 {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
  50% { transform: rotate(-20deg) scale(1.15) translateY(-3px); }
}

.avatar-badge {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -10px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink), var(--purple));
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 3px 14px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  color: #fff;
  white-space: nowrap;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(244,114,182,0.45);
  z-index: 10;
  animation: badgePulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes badgePulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(244,114,182,0.45); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 4px 25px rgba(244,114,182,0.8), 0 0 40px rgba(167,139,250,0.3); }
}

/* ─── HERO TEXT ─── */
.hero-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.hero-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--cyan);
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.hero-tag::before {
  content: '';
  width: 24px;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--cyan);
}

.hero-name {
  font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 2.8rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.05;
  color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  letter-spacing: -1px;
}

.hero-name .accent { color: var(--pink); }

/* Typing cursor on name */
.cursor {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 3px;
  height: 0.85em;
  background: var(--pink);
  margin-left: 4px;
  vertical-align: middle;
  animation: blink 1s step-end infinite;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

@keyframes blink {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0; }
}

.hero-desc {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #94a3b8;
  line-height: 1.65;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  max-width: 360px;
}

.hero-pills {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.pill {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 1px solid;
  transition: all 0.25s;
  cursor: default;
  animation: pillEntrance 0.5s ease backwards;
}

.pill:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.pill:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.pill:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
.pill:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.pill:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }

@keyframes pillEntrance {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.pill:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }

.p1 { color: #f9a8d4; border-color: rgba(244,114,182,0.35); background: rgba(244,114,182,0.08); }
.p2 { color: #c4b5fd; border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.35); background: rgba(167,139,250,0.08); }
.p3 { color: #67e8f9; border-color: rgba(34,211,238,0.35); background: rgba(34,211,238,0.08); }
.p4 { color: #86efac; border-color: rgba(74,222,128,0.35); background: rgba(74,222,128,0.08); }
.p5 { color: #fcd34d; border-color: rgba(251,191,36,0.35); background: rgba(251,191,36,0.08); }

.hero-email {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  color: var(--muted);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.hero-email .at-sign { color: var(--purple); }

/* ─── ACCENT LINE ─── */
.accent-line {
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--pink), var(--purple), var(--cyan), var(--green), var(--amber));
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  opacity: 0.8;
  animation: lineGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes lineGlow {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: none; opacity: 0.7; }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(167,139,250,0.5); opacity: 1; }
}

/* ─── SECTIONS ─── */
.sec { margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }

.sec-title {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--purple);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2.5px;
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.sec-title::after {
  content: '';
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.3), transparent);
}

/* ─── CARD ─── */
.card {
  background: var(--bg2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 1.3rem;
}

/* ─── ABOUT ─── */
.about-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
.about-item {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px;
  font-size: 12.5px; color: #94a3b8; line-height: 1.5;
  transition: color 0.2s;
}
.about-item:hover { color: var(--text); }
.dot {
  width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px currentColor;
}

/* ─── SKILLS ─── */
.sk-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
.sk {
  background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 12px; padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.sk:hover {
  border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.4);
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}
.sk-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.sk-name { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text); font-weight: 500; }
.sk-pct { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }
.sk-track { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 4px; height: 3px; overflow: hidden; }
.sk-fill {
  height: 3px; border-radius: 4px; width: 0;
  transition: width 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
}

/* ─── TOOLS ─── */
.tools-wrap { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; }
.tool {
  font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  padding: 5px 13px; border-radius: 20px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: #94a3b8; transition: all 0.2s; cursor: default;
}
.tool:hover { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.1); border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.3); color: #c4b5fd; transform: translateY(-2px); }

/* ─── PROJECTS ─── */
.proj-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 9px; }
.proj {
  background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.15rem 1.2rem;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s;
  text-decoration: none; display: block;
}
.proj:hover {
  border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.4);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 20px rgba(167,139,250,0.08);
}
.proj-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.proj-ic {
  width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 16px; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.proj-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; }
.proj-desc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.55; }
.proj-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 9px; }
.ptag { font-size: 10.5px; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }
.plink { font-size: 11px; color: var(--purple); transition: color 0.2s; }
.proj:hover .plink { color: var(--pink); }

/* ─── STATS ─── */
.stats-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
.stat {
  background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.1rem; text-align: center;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.stat:hover { border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.3); transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
.stat-num { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; }
.stat-lbl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 3px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }

/* ─── CONNECT ─── */
.conn-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.conn {
  flex: 1; background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 13px; padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s;
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--text); text-decoration: none;
}
.conn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
.conn-ic {
  width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 9px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 12px; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0;
  font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
}
.conn-label { font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; }
.conn-sub { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 1px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }

/* ─── FOOTER ─── */
.footer {
  text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted);
  margin-top: 1.5rem; padding-top: 1.2rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.footer strong { color: var(--text); }
.footer-sub {
  font-size: 11px; margin-top: 6px;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--pink), var(--purple), var(--cyan));
  -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container">

<!-- HERO -->
<div class="hero" id="hero">
  <img class="hero-bg" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="bg"/>
  <div class="hero-overlay"></div>
  <div class="hero-overlay2"></div>

  <!-- Matrix coding rain canvas -->
  <canvas id="matrixCanvas"></canvas>

  <!-- Floating code snippets -->
  <div class="code-float" id="cf1" style="left:62%;bottom:20px;color:#a78bfa;animation-duration:5s;animation-delay:0s;">df.groupby('region').sum()</div>
  <div class="code-float" id="cf2" style="left:55%;bottom:15px;color:#22d3ee;animation-duration:6s;animation-delay:1.5s;">SELECT * FROM sales WHERE year=2024</div>
  <div class="code-float" id="cf3" style="left:58%;bottom:10px;color:#f472b6;animation-duration:4.5s;animation-delay:3s;">plt.show() ✓</div>
  <div class="code-float" id="cf4" style="left:65%;bottom:25px;color:#4ade80;animation-duration:7s;animation-delay:2s;">import pandas as pd</div>

  <div class="hero-inner">
    <div class="avatar-wrap">
      <div class="avatar-glow"></div>
      <div class="avatar-ring"></div>
      <div class="avatar-ring-mask"></div>
      <img class="avatar-img" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Mansi Nishad"/>
      <span class="emoji-pop ep1">💻</span>
      <span class="emoji-pop ep2">✨</span>
      <span class="emoji-pop ep3">📊</span>
      <div class="avatar-badge">Data Analyst</div>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-text">
      <div class="hero-tag">Hi there, I am</div>
      <div class="hero-name">Mansi <span class="accent">Nishad</span><span class="cursor"></span></div>
      <div class="hero-desc">Aspiring Data Analyst &nbsp;·&nbsp; Turning raw data into meaningful stories &amp; insights</div>
      <div class="hero-pills">
        <span class="pill p1">Power BI</span>
        <span class="pill p2">Python</span>
        <span class="pill p3">SQL</span>
        <span class="pill p4">Excel</span>
        <span class="pill p5">Data Viz</span>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-email">
        <span class="at-sign">@</span>mansinishad123123@gmail.com
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="accent-line"></div>

<!-- ABOUT -->
<div class="sec">
  <div class="sec-title">About Me</div>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="about-grid">
      <div class="about-item"><span class="dot" style="background:var(--pink);color:var(--pink)"></span>Working on Data Analytics Projects</div>
      <div class="about-item"><span class="dot" style="background:var(--purple);color:var(--purple)"></span>Learning Python, Data Viz &amp; Analytics</div>
      <div class="about-item"><span class="dot" style="background:var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan)"></span>Tools: Jupyter Notebook, MySQL Workbench</div>
      <div class="about-item"><span class="dot" style="background:var(--green);color:var(--green)"></span>Focus: Dashboarding &amp; Actionable Insights</div>
      <div class="about-item"><span class="dot" style="background:#fb923c;color:#fb923c"></span>Turning raw data into meaningful stories</div>
      <div class="about-item"><span class="dot" style="background:var(--pink);color:var(--pink)"></span>Always Learning | Always Building</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- SKILLS -->
<div class="sec">
  <div class="sec-title">Skill Levels</div>
  <div class="sk-grid">
    <div class="sk"><div class="sk-top"><span class="sk-name">Excel / Advanced</span><span class="sk-pct">90%</span></div><div class="sk-track"><div class="sk-fill" data-w="90" style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f472b6,#a78bfa)"></div></div></div>
    <div class="sk"><div class="sk-top"><span class="sk-name">SQL</span><span class="sk-pct">85%</span></div><div class="sk-track"><div class="sk-fill" data-w="85" style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a78bfa,#22d3ee)"></div></div></div>
    <div class="sk"><div class="sk-top"><span class="sk-name">Data Visualization</span><span class="sk-pct">88%</span></div><div class="sk-track"><div class="sk-fill" data-w="88" style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#22d3ee,#4ade80)"></div></div></div>
    <div class="sk"><div class="sk-top"><span class="sk-name">Python / Pandas</span><span class="sk-pct">80%</span></div><div class="sk-track"><div class="sk-fill" data-w="80" style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f472b6,#fb923c)"></div></div></div>
    <div class="sk"><div class="sk-top"><span class="sk-name">Power BI</span><span class="sk-pct">78%</span></div><div class="sk-track"><div class="sk-fill" data-w="78" style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fb923c,#f472b6)"></div></div></div>

<script>
// ─── MATRIX RAIN ───
(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('matrixCanvas');
  const hero = document.getElementById('hero');
  
  function resize() {
    canvas.width = hero.offsetWidth;
    canvas.height = hero.offsetHeight;
  }
  resize();

  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const chars = 'アイウエオカキクケコPYTHONSQLDATAPANDASNUMPYMATRIXANALYSIS01select*from<>==!=+[]{}()import def class return print'.split('');
  const fontSize = 11;
  const cols = Math.floor(canvas.width / fontSize);
  const drops = Array(cols).fill(1).map(() => Math.random() * -50);
  
  const colors = ['#a78bfa', '#f472b6', '#22d3ee', '#4ade80', '#fbbf24'];

  function draw() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(7,5,15,0.08)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.font = fontSize + 'px JetBrains Mono, monospace';
    
    for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
      const char = chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
      const colorIdx = Math.floor(i / cols * colors.length) % colors.length;
      
      // Leading char brighter
      if (drops[i] * fontSize < canvas.height) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = colors[colorIdx];
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
      }
      
      ctx.fillText(char, i * fontSize, drops[i] * fontSize);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

      if (drops[i] * fontSize > canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.975) {
        drops[i] = 0;
      }
      drops[i] += 0.4;
    }
  }

  setInterval(draw, 55);
})();

// ─── SKILL BAR ANIMATION ───
(function() {
  const fills = document.querySelectorAll('.sk-fill');
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const el = entry.target;
        const w = el.getAttribute('data-w');
        setTimeout(() => { el.style.width = w + '%'; }, 200);
        observer.unobserve(el);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.3 });
  fills.forEach(f => observer.observe(f));
})();
</script>
